description:
Modern 1-Bedroom Apartment To Rent in Secure Lifestyle Complex
            
            This well-appointed 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a popular and well-managed 24-hour security complex, offering a safe and comfortable lock-up-and-go lifestyle.
            
            The unit features a bright open-plan living and dining area, seamlessly flowing into a modern kitchen. The bedroom is generously sized with built-in cupboards, while the bathroom is neat and functional with quality finishes.
            
            Lifestyle & Complex Features:
            
            24-hour manned security and access control
            
            Sparkling communal swimming pool
            
            Fully equipped gym
            
            Beautifully maintained communal areas
            
            Additional Property Features:
            
            Prepaid water and electricity
            
            Secure undercover parking
            
            Third-floor position offering privacy and views
            
            Prime Location:
            Conveniently situated close to major roads and transport routes, with easy access to shopping malls, medical facilities, and essential amenities. The complex is located near a golf course and is just 5 minutes from the beach, making it ideal for those who enjoy an active coastal lifestyle.
            
            Perfect for a single professional or couple seeking security, convenience, and lifestyle living in a sought-after area.
